changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM BOARD_TASK_PHOTO_LINK WHERE PHOTO_ID IN ( SELECT p.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM_EVENT_PHOTO p WHERE p.EVENT_ID IN ( SELECT e.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM_EVENT e WHERE e.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) ) OR BOARD_TASK_ID IN ( SELECT bt.ID FROM BOARD_TASK bt WHERE bt.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) OR bt.REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR bt.ID IN ( SELECT tp.GENERATED_BOARD_TASK_ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_TASK_PLAN tp WHERE tp.GENERATED_BOARD_TASK_ID IS NOT NULL AND ( tp.ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR tp.REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) ) ) );

DELETE FROM TASK_ASSIGNMENT WHERE QUEUE_ENTRY_ID IN ( SELECT qe.ID FROM QUEUE_ENTRY qe WHERE qe.TASK_ID IN ( SELECT bt.ID FROM BOARD_TASK bt WHERE bt.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) OR bt.REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR bt.ID IN ( SELECT tp.GENERATED_BOARD_TASK_ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_TASK_PLAN tp WHERE tp.GENERATED_BOARD_TASK_ID IS NOT NULL AND ( tp.ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR tp.REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) ) ) ) );

DELETE FROM TASK_TIME_EVENT WHERE QUEUE_ENTRY_ID IN ( SELECT qe.ID FROM QUEUE_ENTRY qe WHERE qe.TASK_ID IN ( SELECT bt.ID FROM BOARD_TASK bt WHERE bt.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) OR bt.REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR bt.ID IN ( SELECT tp.GENERATED_BOARD_TASK_ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_TASK_PLAN tp WHERE tp.GENERATED_BOARD_TASK_ID IS NOT NULL AND ( tp.ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR tp.REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) ) ) ) );

DELETE FROM QUEUE_ENTRY WHERE TASK_ID IN ( SELECT bt.ID FROM BOARD_TASK bt WHERE bt.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) OR bt.REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR bt.ID IN ( SELECT tp.GENERATED_BOARD_TASK_ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_TASK_PLAN tp WHERE tp.GENERATED_BOARD_TASK_ID IS NOT NULL AND ( tp.ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR tp.REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) ) ) );

DELETE FROM REPAIR_PROCESS_TASK_LINE WHERE TASK_PLAN_ID IN ( SELECT tp.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_TASK_PLAN tp WHERE tp.ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR tp.ESTIMATE_LINE_ID IN ( SELECT rel.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_LINE rel WHERE rel.ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) ) OR tp.REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) ) OR ESTIMATE_LINE_ID IN ( SELECT rel.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_LINE rel WHERE rel.ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) );

DELETE FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_TASK_PLAN WHERE ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) OR ESTIMATE_LINE_ID IN ( SELECT rel.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_LINE rel WHERE rel.ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) ) ) OR REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) );

UPDATE REPAIR_ESTIMATE SET LATEST_EVENT_ID = NULL WHERE RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) AND LATEST_EVENT_ID IN ( SELECT e.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM_EVENT e WHERE e.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) );

DELETE FROM RENTAL_ITEM_EVENT_PHOTO WHERE EVENT_ID IN ( SELECT e.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM_EVENT e WHERE e.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) );
DELETE FROM RENTAL_ITEM_EVENT WHERE RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL );

DELETE FROM BOARD_TASK WHERE RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) OR REPAIR_PROCESS_ID IN ( SELECT rp.ID FROM REPAIR_PROCESS rp WHERE rp.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) );
DELETE FROM REPAIR_PROCESS WHERE RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL );

DELETE FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE_LINE WHERE ESTIMATE_ID IN ( SELECT re.ID FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE re WHERE re.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) );
DELETE FROM REPAIR_ESTIMATE WHERE RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL );

DELETE FROM RESERVATION_ACCESSORY WHERE RESERVATION_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT rl.ID FROM RESERVATION_LINE rl WHERE rl.WAREHOUSE_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) OR rl.STOCK_ITEM_ID IN ( '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000701', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000702', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000703' ) ) OR RESERVATION_ID IN ( SELECT r.ID FROM RESERVATION r WHERE r.RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) );

DELETE FROM RESERVATION_LINE WHERE WAREHOUSE_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL ) OR STOCK_ITEM_ID IN ( '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000701', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000702', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000703' );
DELETE FROM RESERVATION WHERE RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL );
DELETE FROM RENTAL_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE WHERE RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL );
DELETE FROM RENTAL_ITEM_TAG WHERE RENTAL_ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT ri.ID FROM RENTAL_ITEM ri WHERE ri.CREATED_DATE IS NULL AND ri.CREATED_BY IS NULL );
